name: agent-desktop
description: Computer use CLI for AI agents
one_liner: Lets an AI agent actually operate desktop apps (click buttons, type into fields) on Mac, Windows, and Linux, instead of just reading a screenshot and guessing.
buyer: An operations manager stuck with old desktop software (accounting, inventory, scheduling) that has no API, who wants repetitive data entry automated without replacing the software.
business_use_cases: An automation shop builds bots that key data into legacy Windows accounting or ERP software that has no API, billing clients monthly for the automation.
A QA team builds AI-driven regression testers for desktop applications that click through the same workflows a human tester would.
An accessibility consultancy audits third-party desktop apps' accessibility trees for compliance, using the tool's structured output as evidence.

money_ideas.idea: Subscription automation service that handles one tedious back-office desktop workflow for a small business.
One-off custom automation builds for companies stuck on legacy desktop software.

steal_this: Pick one tedious task a local accounting firm does by hand in old desktop software (e.g. invoice entry) and build a small agent that does it automatically — sell it as a $200/month add-on.
